\# mse loss | marginrankingloss

```{r}

e <- readRDS("data/sce.EC.scAlign.assigned.rds")
s <- readRDS("data/sce.SFG.scAlign.assigned.rds")

colData(e)$source <- "EC"
colData(s)$source <- "SFG"

sce_merged <- cbind(e,s)
```


```{r}
bp <-BiocParallel::MulticoreParam(workers = 10)
```


```{r}
sce_merged <- runUMAP(sce_merged, name = "UMAP_merged", n_threads=10)
```



```{r}
plotReducedDim(sce_merged, dimred = "UMAP_merged",colour_by="source")
```

# Scoring markers by pairwise comparisons

```{r}
# marker information per cluster
marker_info <- scoreMarkers(sce_merged, sce_merged$seurat.clusters)
```


```{r}
nrow(marker_info[[1]]); nrow(marker_info[[2]])
```


```{r}
# selecting cluster 1
chosen <- marker_info[[1]]
chosen <- chosen[order(chosen$mean.AUC, decreasing = TRUE), ]
```



```{r}
plotExpression(sce_merged, features = head(rownames(chosen)), x = "seurat.clusters", colour_by = "seurat.clusters")
```



# Model




```{r}
ordinal_classifier <- nn_module(
  "ordinal_classifier",
  initialize = function(){
    #browser()
    # self$gene_names
    self$layers <- nn_sequential(
      nn_dropout(),
      nn_linear(in_features = 33694L, out_features = 5120L), nn_tanh(),
      nn_linear(in_features = 5120L, out_features = 1024L), nn_relu(),
      nn_linear(in_features = 1024L, out_features = 1L)
    ) 
  },
  
  forward = function(x){
    x |> self$layers()
  }
)
```



```{r}
#torch_set_default_dtype(torch_float())
fitted <- ordinal_classifier |>
  setup(loss = nn_mse_loss(),
        optimizer = optim_adam) |>
  # set_hparams() |>
  fit(train_ds,
      epochs=2L,
      dataloader_options=list(batch_size=100L)
      #, accelerator=accelerator(cpu = TRUE)
      )


      # callbacks=list(luz_callback_model_checkpoint("models/model_stage_class_best_valid_acc.luz", monitor="valid_acc", mode = "max", save_best_only=TRUE),
      #                luz_callback_model_checkpoint("models/model_stage_class_best_train_acc.luz", monitor="train_acc", mode = "max", save_best_only=TRUE))
```

```{r}
luz_save(fitted, "models/ord_class_mse.luz")
```

## Data prep

```{r}
sce_sampled <- sce_merged[, sample(seq(1:dim(sce_merged)[2]), size = 10e3)]

train <- sce_sampled[, sample(seq(1:dim(sce_sampled)[2]), size = dim(sce_sampled)[2]*.7)]
test <- sce_sampled[, !colnames(sce_sampled) %in% colnames(train)]

```




```{r}
train_ds <- tensor_dataset(
  x=torch_tensor(t(as.matrix(logcounts(train)))),
  y=torch_tensor(as.matrix(as.numeric(train$BraakStage), ncol=1), dtype=torch_float())
)
```



```{r prados_list_dataset}
delayed_ds <- dataset(
  name = "DelayedArray_dataset",
  initialize = function(arrays) {
      self$arrays <- arrays
      #self$dtypes <- dtypes
  },
  .length = function() {nrow(self$arrays[[1]])},
  .getbatch = function(index) {
      Map(function(x) {
        # browser()
        x <- as.matrix(x[index, , drop=FALSE])
        y <- as.matrix(x[index,drop=FALSE])
        torch_tensor(x)
      },self$arrays)
  }
  # .getitem = function(index) {
  #     if (is.list(index)) {index <- unlist(index)}
  #     self$.getbatch(index)
  # }
)
```


```{r prados_delayed_ds}

delayed_ds <- dataset(
  name = "sce_dataset",
 
  initialize = function(x,y) {
    self$x <- x;self$y <- y
    stopifnot(identical(length(y),nrow(x)))
  },
 
  .length = function() {length(self$y)},
 
  .getbatch = function(index) { list(
    x = torch_tensor(as.matrix(self$x[index, ,drop=FALSE]), torch_float()),
    y = torch_tensor(as.matrix(self$y[index], ncol=1), torch_float())
  )},
 
  .getitem = function(index) {
    if (is.list(index)) {index <- unlist(index)}
    self$.getbatch(index)
  }
)
```



```{r}
train_ds <- delayed_ds(x=t(logcounts(train)), y=as.numeric(train$BraakStage))
```


## Loss function


```{r}
l <- nnf_margin_ranking_loss(input1 = pred[ij[,1]], input2= pred[ij[,2]], target = sign(target[ij[,1]] - target[ij[,2]]),reduction = "none",margin = 1)

cbind(as_array(ij), as_array(pred[ij[,1]]), as_array(pred[ij[,2]]),as_array(target[ij[,1]]) ,as_array(target[ij[,2]]) ,as_array(l))
```



```{r}
pred <- torch_tensor(as.numeric(as.character(train$BraakStage[1:10])))
target <- torch_tensor(as.numeric(as.character(train$BraakStage[5:14])))
```


```{r}
ij <- torch_combinations(torch_arange(1,length(pred), dtype = torch_long()))
```
